abilities.name: Malefic Visions
notes:
Malefic Vision's cast is special cased to not be cancelled if the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time.
  - The debuff is not applied if the target is untargetable by the time the cast completes.

abilities.name: Void Shift

evidence.quote: Void Shift: Malzahar gains crowd control immunity and 90% damage reduction.

notes: Void Shift will not resist allied crowd control nor will it be deactivated by them.

Shields will take priority over Void Shift, but the buff is always consumed, even if the shield fully mitigates the damage.
  - However, if Malzahar has a spell shield and is hit by an effect that isn't negated by the spell shield, then if the shield fully mitigates the damage, Void Shift will not be consumed.
Spell shields take priority over Void Shift for abilities that contain a crowd control effect.

abilities.name: Call of the Void

evidence.quote: After 0.4 seconds, enemies between the portals are dealt magic damage and silenced for a duration.

notes:
Spell shield will prevent Call of the Void's refresh on Malefic Visions.
  - Malefic Visions debuff will also be removed.

abilities.name: Nether Grasp

evidence.quote: Active: Malzahar tethers to the target enemy champion, knocking them down.
He then channels for up to 2.5 seconds, suppressing and revealing the target and dealing them magic damage every 0.25 seconds, revealing himself in the process.

notes: Spell shield prevents both the tether and the Null Zone from appearing, however Malzahar will continue to channel. [https://www.reddit.com/r/Sivir/comments/g7yt38/if_you_shield_malzahar_ult_he_ironically_gets_ccd/]

As long as the target is within the tether radius, they will take the full tether damage over 2.5 seconds even if they are not tethered due to the tether being broken early into the channel.
  - This occurs regardless of how the tether was broken.
  - If the target exits tether range they will stop taking damage, but can be damaged again by the remaining ticks if they re-enter the tether range within the duration.
Removing the suppression will also remove the reveal.
Malzahar places himself onto the ground and interrupts displacements affecting him upon starting the channel.

The following table refers for interactions while Malzahar is channeling:
  - The channel will be interrupted if the tether is broken.
